build_nf_regnet_model: build a Normalizer-Free RegNet model with a specified variant like B0 for image classification
run_nf_regnet_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the NF_RegNet model to get logits and pooled features
count_nf_regnet_flops: count the FLOPs of an NF_RegNet model given input height and width dimensions
build_nf_block: build an NFBlock with configurable expansion ratio, squeeze-excite ratio, and stochastic depth
run_nf_block_forward: run a forward pass through an NFBlock with skip connection and stochastic depth support
